The Play-In Stage features a 4-team, double-elimination bracket, which qualifies one team into the Swiss Stage— where they will join 15 challengers from around the global to compete for the Summoners Cup at the Grand Final in New York City.

To learn more about the Worlds format, check out https://riot.com/worlds2026format

Play-Ins: October 15-18
